description: M4-10: LRU bounds on the word-decoder and char-LM memos (PhonemeWordDecoder cache_size, CharNgramLM cache_size; fidetype.lm.cache.LRUCache). Decision equality with the unbounded caches (long synthetic session and the 816 B2T '25 test streams), cache sizes and RSS over a long synthetic session, push / end latency at prewarm budget 1 ms. CPU only.

session.data: synthetic phoneme streams: Tatoeba English sentences (3-12 words, all words in CMUdict; seed-sampled) -> CMUdict pronunciations with random phoneme substitutions / deletions / insertions -> frames (1-2 frames per symbol, optional blank, Gaussian logits with a peak on the symbol and a smaller peak on a random other symbol)
session.decoder: as M4-09: phoneme CTC prefix beam (vector, beam 64, n_best 20, no LM) -> PhonemeWordDecoder (CMUdict, word unigram, char 6-gram); frozen M4-06 split-A config (ours)
session.runs: none = all memos unbounded; default = library defaults (word candidates 5000, sentence-LM 50000, char-LM 200000); an int n = n for both word memos and min(n, 200000) for the char-LM memo. The run '50000' was made before the defaults were split (then the default was 50000 for both word memos); it is kept as a measured setting.
session.gc: gc.collect() + gc.freeze() after setup; automatic GC off during the session; one gc.collect() after each final decision (idle point, timed separately)

b2t.data: Brain-to-Text '25 copy task (Card et al. 2024, T15, CC0): the 816 split-A test trials as full-precision NTS JSON Lines written by M4-06
b2t.caches: word decoder caches cleared at the start of each condition and kept across its trials (as in a live session); char-LM memo replaced by a fresh LRUCache with the bound of the run (see session.runs)
